newsitem.title: USA: BMG, Wachovia launch Visa card.
newsitem.headline: BMG, Wachovia launch Visa card.

text.p: BMG Entertainment North America and Wachovia Bank Card Services said Monday they signed an agreement to offer the BMG Visa credit card.
The credit card will provide cardholders with rewards available through a major, global music company.
Cardholders will earn points that can be redeemed for BMG Entertainment artist-specific rewards. The BMG Visa credit card will be launched in September 1997, they said.

The rewards include tickets and backstage passes to concerts; awards shows and special events; limited edition promotional CDs and special compilations; autographed memorabilia; rare music and videos; and other specially packaged products -- much of which is not traditionally available through music retail stores, music clubs or on-line retailers.
BMG is a division of Germany's Bertelsmann AG.
